title: /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/project-LICHEN/firmware/bridge-zephyr/subsys/lichen/lichen_l2.c:608 peer_try_all_pubkeys() calls lichen_link_rx() twice for valid frames - first at line 585 during peer iteration (which commits replay state), then again at line 608 after the loop. The second call fails with -EALREADY because the sequence number was already marked as seen by the first call. This causes all valid signed frames from known peers to be rejected.
close_reason: Fixed by wave-fix: removed redundant second lichen_link_rx() call, saved output length from first successful call
